description: Is this healthcare provider sanctioned or excluded from the Illinois Medicaid program? Screens a person or business name, an NPI, and/or a license number against the Illinois Department of Healthcare and Family Services (HFS) Office of Inspector General Provider Sanctions list: the state-level counterpart to the federal HHS OIG LEIE (leie pack) for Illinois, and sibling of tx_medical_check_exclusion, ny_omig_check_exclusion, ca_medical_check_exclusion and fl_medical_check_exclusion. Answers "is this provider barred from Illinois Medicaid", "check this NPI against the Illinois sanctions list", or pre-payment/credentialing screening for an Illinois Medicaid provider. An NPI or license-number match is an IDENTIFICATION; a name match, even an exact one, is a CANDIDATE lead only (the list has no date of birth). Each match carries the action type (Terminated, Barred, Exclusion, Suspended, Voluntary Withdrawal), the action date, provider type and any affiliated business. The response leads with counts by action type. No street addresses are served. Sourced from the Illinois HFS OIG, keyless.

license.description: Illinois professional license number, if known. A license match is an identification.

name.description: Provider or business name to screen, e.g. "Alrifai Tamer" or "Royal Transportation". Any word order.

npi.description: The provider's 10-digit NPI, if known. An NPI match is an identification. Always pass it when known.
